The hardest failures in serious software rarely happen inside one feature.

They happen between boundaries:
- product ↔ workflow
- architecture ↔ implementation
- data ↔ accountability
- review ↔ deployed revision

That is the territory we work in at Moebiusol—across MedTech, software architecture and governed agentic AI.

I’ll share practical field notes from what we build, test and learn.
